findings.text: the landed change repurposes this file from the first aggregate to the re-run aggregate, so docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab.html:3 still carries the literal 'Neither condition is satisfied' that the brief's first named defect asked to fix, and no runner now produces that fragment. The file is in the granted write scope while the fragment that carries the defect is not, so the node could not have corrected it in place; the coordinator owns the follow-on.

the assertion compares the classifier's batches_run against the same value the test handed in, and its fixture sets batches_total to 2 as well, so a regression that read the wrong batch key would still pass a green assertion.

_score_lower_in_held skips a member whose jev score is not numeric, because classify_record (line 176) maps every member through scores_after.get; a record whose scores_after omits a member therefore yields None, _score_lower_in_held skips it, and the score condition passes on a member that was never measured. That is the same unreadable-read-as-absent failure the brief's fifth defect forbids, one level down from the top-level required-field check.

the held-score section renders an absent hold reason as {} (line 731) and then asserts at line 752 that the 0.849 is 'a genuine documentation hold on the wall-recombination neutral member in both arms', although only one of the six compared records (the wall-recombination jev arm) carries a documentation_holds note at all. The heuristic arm's hold is inferred from a score rather than read from its apply log, and the fragment gives the reader no way to tell the two apart.

the population paragraph tells the reader the compared records are cited with their code revision and their revisions named, but the fragment names only the fixed tree (284f17bcba6f17457c54d40527d5f1776f6fa0e9); the six per-record revisions live in the JSON and appear nowhere in the HTML, so the sentence overstates what the fragment shows.

the figure caption and the score-condition prose rest on a comparison in which one compared arm did not finish: energy_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination jev ran 1 of 2 batches and halted at 0.00 percent documentation acceptance. No sentence in the fragment says the failing score condition turns on an incomplete apply, which is the confound the fixed-tree ruling exists to avoid; the table records the halt but the verdict does not carry it.
